topic: Sukuna tore off one of Yuji's fingers, force-fed it to Megumi, and permanently transferred his soul into Megumi's body, taking complete control instantly without hesitation
title: Sukuna Abandoned Yuji For A Better Body
description: For months Sukuna shared Yuji's body, a compromise neither wanted. Then Sukuna decided Yuji's body simply wasn't good enough for him anymore. He tore off his own finger, forced it into Megumi's mouth, and transferred his soul completely. Yuji fought to stop it with everything he had and lost anyway.
comment: Did Sukuna plan from the start to possess Megumi, or did he just get impatient with Yuji's limitations?

lines.text: Sukuna had spent months sharing Yuji's body, but decided Yuji's power simply wasn't good enough for him anymore.
He'd been impressed by Megumi since their first fight. Megumi had the technique Sukuna actually wanted.

shot.fallback: calculating figure remembering a worthy opponent

lines.text: So Sukuna tore off Yuji's own pinky finger and force-fed it directly to Megumi to complete the transfer.

shot.fallback: forced transfer imposed on unwilling target

lines.text: His soul moved out of Yuji and into Megumi instantly, taking full control of a body with its own incredible technique.

shot.fallback: soul shifting into a more suitable vessel

lines.text: Yuji fought to stop it with everything he had. He lost anyway, watching helplessly as his own friend's body was taken over.
Inside Megumi's body, Sukuna used Hana's own trust against her, hurting her while she was still hugging who she thought was Megumi.
He demoralizes Megumi's own will from the inside, pushing him toward giving up entirely.

shot.search: Sukuna attacks Megumi spirit inside body
shot.fallback: intimate cruelty from within a stolen body

lines.text: That's the real cost of Sukuna's underestimation: he finally got the body he wanted, but it came with a fight he didn't expect...

shot.search: Megumi resists inside body fight ahead
shot.fallback: internal struggle beginning in a stolen vessel

self_check.hook: line 1 establishes Sukuna's impatience, lines 2-4 show his decision and execution, line 5 makes it personal with Yuji's failure
self_check.loop: last line returns to the consequence (Megumi's resistance) that Sukuna didn't anticipate
